items.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued November 26 at 3:19PM EST until November 27 at 1:00AM EST by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 12
to 18 feet expected in the surf zone. For the Coastal Flood
Warning, 2 to 3 feet of inundation above ground level expected
in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways.

* WHERE...Virginia Beach.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Warning, until 1 AM EST Friday.
For the High Surf Advisory, until 7 AM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Major flooding has led to extensive inundation and
flooding of numerous roads and buildings resulting in a
significant threat to property and life. Water levels are
slowly falling, but will still be 2 to 3 feet or more above
ground level in some areas. Flooding may extend inland from
the waterfront and shoreline, flooding homes, businesses and
isolating some neighborhoods. Numerous roads have been closed
and may remain impassable under several feet of water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The high tide cycle that occurred earlier
today was the peak for this event, with the upcoming tide
cycle this evening into tonight several feet lower. However,
the Coastal Flood Warning has been extended into early Friday
due to widespread residual high water.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.

Inexperienced swimmers should remain out of the water due to
dangerous surf conditions.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 26 at 2:47PM EST until November 27 at 10:00PM EST by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts to 30 kt, shifting
to the southwest 25 to 30 kt with gusts to 40 kt tonight through
Friday. Seas 15 to 20 ft, subsiding to 8 to 15 kt.

* WHERE...Portions of Atlantic coastal waters.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
